segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: A question was put to Israel long ago — who gets to climb the hill of the LORD and stand in his holy place?

segments.speaker: scripture
segments.text: Who shall ascend into the hill of the LORD? or who shall stand in his holy place?

segments.speaker: scripture
segments.text: He that hath clean hands, and a pure heart; who hath not lifted up his soul unto vanity, nor sworn deceitfully.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: The answer was not about bloodline or rank.

segments.speaker: scripture
segments.text: Lift up your heads, O ye gates; and be ye lift up, ye everlasting doors; and the King of glory shall come in.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Then the call goes out to the gates themselves — lift up your heads, you ancient doors,

segments.speaker: scripture
segments.text: Who is this King of glory? The LORD strong and mighty, the LORD mighty in battle.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: He is the one who comes in.

segments.speaker: scripture
segments.text: He shall receive the blessing from the LORD, and righteousness from the God of his salvation.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Such a one receives blessing from the LORD, and righteousness from the God of their salvation.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: The door is open to the one with a clean heart. Come and stand in his presence.
